Hey all — engineering detail below (short form for the change ticket).

1) Control-plane egress IPs- Provided as a tight, documented pool: 52.41.120.8/29 and 18.197.33.160/29 (example only) — two /29s covering the control-plane API, metrics, and billing endpoints. These are allocated from our managed egress NAT layer for private deployments.

2) Stability and rotation- The addresses above are stable for customer-tenanted private control planes and are not expected to change more frequently than quarterly. In exceptional cases (capacity growth / regional rehoming) we provide 30 days notice and a migration plan with target addresses. We do not use per-request ephemeral outbound NAT for control-plane telemetry.

3) Data-plane origin behaviour- Customer inference traffic is not proxied through Redwood egress. Responses and model payloads flow over the private connector (example: direct VPC peering / Transit gateway) — no outbound rules required on your side for inference egress.

4) SNI / Host patterns for inspection- TLS SNI: api.redwood-inference.com-control (note the suffix), and Host headers for HTTP checks: control.redwood-inference.com and telemetry.redwood-inference.com. If you use wildcard matching, we recommend permitting *.redwood-inference.com but restricting to the two subdomains above where possible.

5) Recommended firewall rules (minimal)
- Allow TCP 443 to 52.41.120.8/29 and 18.197.33.160/29 (control plane endpoints)
- Allow outbound DNS (UDP 53) to your resolver(s)
- Allow NTP if you enforce time sync inspections

6) Evidence bundle for auditors- We'll provide a signed manifest (PDF) listing the IPs and an operational contact for rotation notices. Laura — can you attach the manifest and a short paragraph the change ticket can copy verbatim?

Jordan Blake
Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference

Sara — attaching the short checklist and copyable language for your change ticket. Quick notes included inline below the checklist.

Checklist (to paste into change request):
- Allow outbound TCP/443 to the following stable control-plane CIDRs: 52.41.120.8/29, 18.197.33.160/29
- Allow DNS (UDP/53) to the cluster resolver(s) specified by MedSys
- Do not open inbound ports to Redwood; all connections are customer-initiated over the private connector
- For packet inspection: allow TLS SNI api.redwood-inference.com-control and Host header control.redwood-inference.com, telemetry.redwood-inference.com
- For audit evidence: Redwood will provide a signed IP manifest and rotation notice 30 days prior to any change

Copyable change-note (one paragraph):
"Redwood Inference private runtime requires outbound HTTPS to Redwood control-plane CIDRs (52.41.120.8/29, 18.197.33.160/29). No inbound openings are necessary. Redwood will deliver a signed manifest of egress addresses and 30 days notice for any planned rotation. TLS SNI values are api.redwood-inference.com-control and Host headers control.redwood-inference.com and telemetry.redwood-inference.com for inspection rules."
